actualVisualInspection.method: Root physically viewed the actual Ocelot MGSV portrait and all three unmodified RIGHT/LEFT/correction PNG sheets. Mapped locomotion, repaired counter, SAA low/upright fire and reload grips, hair/scarf/coat and empty hand CQC directly checked.

limits: Source-only exact-job approval. No GUI, mode, Git runtime activation or Vercel admission.

Adult MGSV Ocelot is preserved as a distinct younger incarnation, head bare with grey-blond ponytail, red scarf and brown coat. No MGS2 graft/aged face or red beret is added. Original authored Dite/postapocalyptic variant, not an official outfit or absolute retail 1:1 certificate.
Added bilateral protective shoulder pads and worn materials are intentional fan adaptation. No unique canonical unilateral shoulder device is claimed.
Main3 uses its real bent-knee passing drawing; corrective long heel steps remain unused. World gait size and foot placement must pass UI review before admission.
SAA reload can use left hand weapon with right hand cartridge, consistent with Ocelot ambidextrous dual revolvers. Small weapon internals are stylized.
Original MGSV actionMap heavy to attack and native9FPS groups are preserved. Nine explicit visual-only deployment/reload/parry deltas do not change any actual combat or ammo timing.
Geometry coverage is measured at alpha>16, not all low-alpha fringe pixels. Manual pelvis axes and image units are proposed visual datums; no absolute physical height certificate.
Original fighter, sprite, historical display worldHeight, combat profile, damage, ammo and real clocks remain unchanged.
